fullTextEN: Hello, my name is Rika.
I am from Heilongjiang, China.

fullTextZH: 现在我住在中国的广州。
fullTextEN: I currently live in Guangzhou, China.
Do you know?
In Thailand,

fullTextZH: 有一个孕妇被推下悬崖的故事。
fullTextEN: there is a story about a pregnant woman being pushed off a cliff.
That's right, not falling off a cliff,
but being pushed off a cliff.
Wow, that's terrifying!

fullTextZH: 对吧，这是一个真实的故事。
fullTextEN: Right? This is a true story.

fullTextZH: 一对中国夫妻在泰国生活。
fullTextEN: A Chinese couple lives in Thailand.

fullTextZH: 结婚前，女人很努力的创业，
fullTextEN: Before marriage, the woman worked hard to start a business,

fullTextZH: 就是自己开公司做生意。
fullTextEN: which means starting her own company.
So she made a lot of money,
and became a wealthy boss.

fullTextZH: 男人听说女人是个有钱的老板，
fullTextEN: The man heard the woman was a wealthy boss,

fullTextZH: 所以很努力的追求女人，
fullTextEN: so he pursued her diligently,
often giving her many flowers,
creating a lot of romance.
So the woman was very moved,
She feels the man loves her.
She feels she has found love.
A few months later,
The two of them had a flash marriage.
Yes, they had a flash marriage.

fullTextZH: 在中国认识的时间不长，
fullTextEN: In China, they didn't know each other for long,
They got married right away.
The speed was like lightning,
We call it a flash marriage.

fullTextZH: 结婚后，丈夫不喜欢工作，
fullTextEN: After marriage, the husband didn't like to work,
He liked gambling.

fullTextZH: 所以他欠了很多很多钱，
fullTextEN: So he owed a lot of money,
He owed a lot of money.

fullTextZH: 妻子帮丈夫还了一部分钱，
fullTextEN: The wife helped the husband pay off part of the debt,

fullTextZH: 剩下的部分让丈夫自己想办法。
fullTextEN: The remaining part she let the husband figure out himself.

fullTextZH: 丈夫觉得自己的妻子很有钱，
fullTextEN: The husband thinks his wife is very rich,

fullTextZH: 但是不愿意帮自己还钱，
fullTextEN: but she is unwilling to help him pay off the debt,
so he is very, very angry.
He doesn't love his wife,
He hates his wife, hates her a lot.
One day in 2019,

fullTextZH: 丈夫带妻子去公园看日出。
fullTextEN: The husband took his wife to the park to watch the sunrise.
Watch the sunrise,

fullTextZH: 是吧，看起来他是一个很浪漫的男人。
fullTextEN: Right, he seems like a very romantic man.

fullTextZH: 那个公园有一个34米高的悬崖，
fullTextEN: That park has a 34-meter high cliff,
Not low, huh, a 34-meter high cliff.

fullTextZH: 他把妻子从34米高的悬崖上推了下去。
fullTextEN: He pushed his wife off a 34-meter high cliff.

fullTextZH: 天啊，这个男人太可怕了！
fullTextEN: Oh my, this man is terrifying!
Do you know?
His wife was pregnant at the time,
The child was already three months old.
She was a pregnant woman,
A pregnant woman who was three months pregnant.
Pregnant woman,

fullTextZH: 被丈夫从34米高的悬崖上推了下去。
fullTextEN: Pushed off a 34-meter high cliff by her husband.
So terrifying!
34 meters high, huh!
What do you think happened to the pregnant woman?
Did she die or not?
What about the child?
In the end, the pregnant woman didn't die,
The child was gone.
It was truly a miracle.
Why didn't the pregnant woman die?

fullTextZH: 一是因为她被路过的游客看到了，
fullTextEN: First, because she was seen by passing tourists,

fullTextZH: 发现了，马上送去了医院。
fullTextEN: she was discovered and immediately taken to the hospital.

fullTextZH: 二是因为她掉下悬崖的时候，
fullTextEN: Second, because when she fell off the cliff,
she was stopped by a tree.

fullTextZH: 但是她撞到了很多地方，
fullTextEN: But she hit many places,
hit her head,
hit her arm,
hit her ribs,
hit her thigh,
hit her knee,
hit her toes.
She was seriously injured.
The doctor said her head,
arm, ribs,
thigh, knee,
and toes were all fractured.
Everything is fractured,
but she didn't die.
It's truly a miracle.
After the wife woke up in the hospital,
she didn't dare tell the police,

fullTextZH: 是丈夫把她推下了悬崖。
fullTextEN: it was her husband who pushed her off the cliff.
Because the husband said,

fullTextZH: 如果妻子把这件事情说出去，
fullTextEN: if the wife told anyone about this,
he would kill her.
This man is terrifying!
Later,

fullTextZH: 妻子想办法让朋友帮她告诉了警察。
fullTextEN: the wife found a way to have a friend tell the police.
The husband was taken away by the police.

fullTextZH: 最后丈夫被判了33年的刑，
fullTextEN: In the end, the husband was sentenced to 33 years in prison,
he has to stay in prison for 33 years.
Now 5 years have passed,

fullTextZH: 女人一直在努力的做复健治疗。
fullTextEN: the woman has been working hard on rehabilitation therapy.
She works hard every day.
Now her head,
her arm,
Her ribs,
Her thighs,
Her knees,

fullTextZH: 她的脚趾都恢复健康了。
fullTextEN: Her toes have all recovered.

fullTextZH: 她和她的丈夫也已经离婚了，
fullTextEN: She and her husband have already divorced,
Her life has also improved.

fullTextZH: 你说她的丈夫为什么把她推下悬崖呢？
fullTextEN: Why do you think her husband pushed her off the cliff?
And she was pregnant!
Was it just because he was too angry?
Was it out of hatred?
Maybe the motive wasn't pure.

fullTextZH: 听说男人是想继承女人的钱。
fullTextEN: I heard the man wanted to inherit the woman's money.
It's too terrible!
For money,
He killed his own wife,
He killed a pregnant woman.
What do you think about this matter?

fullTextZH: 一个网友说，女人不能恋爱脑。
fullTextEN: A netizen said women shouldn't be love-brained.
Hmm,
What does love-brained mean?

fullTextZH: 是说脑子里都是恋爱的事情。
fullTextEN: It means that the mind is full of thoughts about love.

fullTextZH: “恋爱脑”这个词用来形容为了爱情，
fullTextEN: The term 'love brain' is used to describe someone who sacrifices for love,
spending too much time,

fullTextZH: 精力、金钱，付出太多的人。这件事，
fullTextEN: energy, and money, giving too much. This person,

fullTextZH: 中的孕妇就是一个恋爱脑。
fullTextEN: the pregnant woman in this case, is a love brain.

fullTextZH: 她因为觉得男人很浪漫，
fullTextEN: She thought the man was very romantic,

fullTextZH: 因为感动，就和男人闪婚。
fullTextEN: and because she was moved, she quickly married him.

fullTextZH: 结婚后，她知道男人喜欢赌钱，
fullTextEN: After marriage, she found out the man liked gambling,
and even helped him pay off some of the debt.
She loves this man too much,
but she doesn't love herself.
She is a love brain.

fullTextZH: 这个网友说，一定不要下嫁，
fullTextEN: This netizen said, you must not marry down,
otherwise it's hard to live happily.
Okay, what is marrying down?

fullTextZH: 她自己是一个有钱的老板，
fullTextEN: She herself is a wealthy boss,
her husband is not as wealthy as she is,
and he doesn't work hard,
only likes gambling.

fullTextZH: 这两个条件不对等的人，
fullTextEN: These two people with unequal conditions,
Of course, their lifestyle habits,
thoughts, and attitudes are all different.
There may be many conflicts.
Originally two people in love,
end up not loving each other,

fullTextZH: 甚至恨。真的很难生活幸福，对吗？
fullTextEN: even hating. It's really hard to live happily, right?

fullTextZH: 还有一个网友说，闪婚要慎重啊！
fullTextEN: Another netizen said, be cautious about flash marriages!
Yes, be cautious!
I think so too.

fullTextZH: 你会和一个，嗯，不认识的人，
fullTextEN: Would you marry someone, um, you don't know,
a newly met person in a flash marriage?

fullTextZH: 你不知道他之前做过什么，
fullTextEN: You don't know what he did before,

fullTextZH: 不知道他做过什么工作，
fullTextEN: don't know what work he did,

fullTextZH: 不知道他认识过什么人，
fullTextEN: don't know who he met,
don't know if he was married,
don't know if he was in jail,

fullTextZH: 等等等等，很多事情都不知道。
fullTextEN: and so on, there are many things you don't know.

fullTextZH: 怎么能马上跟他结婚呢？
fullTextEN: How can you marry him right away?
How can you have a flash marriage with him?
Some say, because of love,
So, a flash marriage.
And what did he do before,
What work did he do,
What people did he know,
Whether he was married,

fullTextZH: 坐没坐过牢都没有关系。
fullTextEN: Whether he was in jail doesn't matter.
Just because of loving this person,
Having love is most important.
Does it really not matter?
Would you have a flash marriage for love?
